claim_boundary: This experiment diagnoses whether the 5-epoch sequence model is undertrained. It must be reported before any SOTA comparison and cannot by itself prove original-paper-level performance.

adequacy_criteria.undertraining_likely: Later epochs improve at least two primary signals by more than 5%.
adequacy_criteria.plateau_or_mixed: Longer training does not consistently improve held-out macro/micro signals.
adequacy_criteria.overfit_or_metric_conflict_possible: Longer training degrades multiple held-out metrics despite training progress.
